<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>UA.Azure.Storage</id>
    <version>10.0.3</version>
    <authors>UA Devs</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>UA.jpg</icon>
    <readme>UA.Azure.Storage.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://docs.uadevs.org/azure-storage</projectUrl>
    <description>UA.Azure.Storage provides a lightweight, efficient implementation for accessing Azure Storage Services (Blob, Queue, and Table) in .NET applications. Built on the Tenet Framework principles, it offers a simplified agent-based approach to interact with Azure Storage without heavy SDK dependencies.</description>
    <releaseNotes>See https://docs.uadevs.org/azure-storage/release-notes for release notes and documentation.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright © UA Devs</copyright>
    <tags>azure storage blob queue table azure-storage tenet agent dotnet csharp</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://dev.azure.com/UADevs/XManager/_git/UA XManager Web" commit="6735263d7560327c91a4e349f05407e18ca2d52e" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="UA.Tenet" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net9.0">
        <dependency id="UA.Tenet" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="UA.Tenet" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
